svg.text: Razorpay AI Buildathon · Track 04, AI Finance Controller

g.text: MDR · GST on fee · TDS 194-O · net
Leg 1 — recomputes expected payout from the rate card, payment by payment
Leg 2 — rolls settlements up by UTR against bank credits in the period

svg.text: figures tie exactly — filed, no further action
a gap remains after both legs — passed on for a reason
reads the evidence from both legs — picks one of nine closed reason codes
any single check below sends the item to a human — the gate itself is rules, not the model
5 of 12 — written to the ledger directly
7 of 12 — held for sign-off, nothing posted
ground_truth.csv — never seen by the resolver — the grader is not the thing being graded
Key finding: chargebacks are not separable from settlement and bank data alone

g.text: Both chargeback batches were correctly identified as ambiguous and referred, not guessed — the resolver returned
“unresolvable,” which is why the two wrong answers never reached the ledger. Closing this needs a fourth
source: the disputes feed. Found by measuring the system, not by anticipating it.
RULES — deterministic, auditable, no model call
CLASSIFICATION ONLY — the sole point the LLM is used

svg.text: Settlement Exception Resolver · Razorpay AI Buildathon · deterministic matching and gating, LLM used only to classify and explain
